comment: 小院慢生活技能表(唯一真相源)。max_level 与 xp_to_next 长度必须一致:xp_to_next[i] = 从 (i+1) 级升到 (i+2) 级所需经验,共 49 项;取整公式 round(50 * level^1.5),放在配置里而不是运行时算,保证跨环境整数确定性。

skills.name: 拾柴
skills.desc: 后山的松林与香樟,捡枝、拾柴、砍木,灶台和木工都靠它。
skills.desc_en: Gather twigs and logs from the hillside grove.

skills.name: 采撷
skills.desc: 草坡上的野莓、薄荷、菌子与野蜜,灶台和酒瓮的原料。
skills.desc_en: Pick berries, mint, mushrooms and wild honey.

skills.name: 垂钓
skills.desc: 溪边的鱼虾,慢一点,但能换更好的价钱。
skills.desc_en: Fish the creek for shrimp and silver-scaled catches.

skills.name: 捡石
skills.desc: 河滩上的卵石、青石与磨石,工具和木工都离不开。
skills.desc_en: Collect pebbles and stone from the riverbank.

skills.name: 灶台
skills.desc: 柴火、鱼和菌子下锅,做出能卖好价的家常菜。
skills.desc_en: Turn firewood, fish and mushrooms into hearty meals.

skills.name: 酒瓮
skills.desc: 野莓与野蜜入瓮,越陈越值钱。
skills.desc_en: Ferment berries and honey into finer brews.

skills.name: 木工
skills.desc: 木头和石头做成盆、凳、磨与匣,也是升级工具的料。
skills.desc_en: Work wood and stone into basins, stools, mills and boxes.
